tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Average Annual Financial Turnover of the Tenderer should not be less than the Amount Put to Tender (However it will be 50% in respect of Micro & Small Enterprises) during the 3 Financial Years i.e., 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 or 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-2026.The audited balance sheets (including profit and loss account sheet) signed by CAs with UDIN and signed by the authorized signatory of the firm for each of the i.e., 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 or 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-2026 shall be scanned and uploaded. Micro & Small Enterprises shall upload valid MSME (UDYAM) registration certificate obtained from the competent authority certifying that tenderer is a Micro and Small Enterprises.

The Liquid Assets as on last date of previous month of tender inviting date or at a later date before submission of the bid consisting of Cash at Bank plus Term Deposits plus availability of fund based credit facilities in any Nationalized/scheduled Bank shall not be less than 25% of the amount put to tender (However it will be 12.5% in respect of Micro & Small Enterprises).The cash at bank, term deposits and availability of fund based credit facilities shall be supported by a certificate issued by Nationalized/ scheduled Bank shall be uploaded in the prescribed format Annexure-B. If the Tenderer has banking with more than one Bank, then the available liquid assets mentioned above on a particular date i.e., as on last date of previous month of tender inviting date or any date before submission of tender shall be the same date for all the banks. In case of Fund based credit facility, the certificate issued by the Nationalized/ Scheduled Bank duly mentioning sanctioned limits, funds utilized so far and balance available as on last date of previous month of tender inviting date or at a later date, before submission of the bid shall be uploaded.
The tenderer shall upload valid GST registration certificate. Valid GST registration certificate shall be uploaded.

The tenderer shall be a manufacturer OR Authorized Dealer of Computers.In case the Tenderer is Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) then Valid certificate should be uploaded. In case the Tenderer is an authorized dealer then, the Tenderer has to upload the Manufacture Authorization Form (MAF) issued by the OEM. Note: During Technical Evaluation MAF will be verified through OEM and qualification will be based on OEM confirmation. In the event, if both the original equipment manufacturer & authorized dealer of same original equipment manufacturer participates in the tender, only the bids of original equipment manufacturer will be considered and the bids of authorized dealer will be rejected.

The tenderer (manufacturer / Authorized dealer) shall have obtained and supplied minimum 80% of the tendered quantity Desktop Computers/Laptops (in total) in any one of the preceding three financial years (i.e. 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 or 2024-25, 2025-26 and 2026-2027) to Government Departments/ PSUs/ Utilities/ Corporate Organizations / Autonomous Bodies/ Research & Educational Institutions in India. In respect of Micro and Small Enterprises the tenderer (for manufacturers only) shall have manufactured, and supplied minimum 40% of the tendered quantity Desktop Computers/Laptops (in total) in any one of the preceding three financial years (i.e. 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 or 2024-25, 2025-26 and 2026-2027 to Government Departments/ PSUs/ Utilities/ Corporate Organizations / Autonomous Bodies/ Research & Educational Institutions in India.In case of manufacturer / Authorized dealer, Purchase Orders and order completion certificates issued by an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer or equivalent officer of the concerned Government Departments/ PSUs/ Utilities/ Corporate Organizations / Autonomous Bodies/ Research & Educational Institutions in India shall be uploaded. In case of an Authorized dealer, the Purchase Orders and Order completion certificate issued in the name of manufacturer shall not be accepted to establish the eligibility of the authorized dealer. Micro & Small Enterprises shall upload valid MSME (UDYAM) registration certificate obtained from the competent authority certifying that tenderer is a Micro and Small Enterprises.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer (manufacturer / Authorized dealer) shall upload performance certificate for satisfactory operation of at least 80% of Desktop Computers /Laptops (40% in case of Micro & Small Enterprises) in any one of the preceding three financial years i.e. 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 or 2024-25, 2025-26 and 2026-2027 from Government Departments/ PSUs/ Utilities/ Corporate Organizations/ Autonomous Bodies/ Research & Educational Institutions in India. The performance certificate issued by an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer or equivalent officer of the concerned Government Departments/ PSUs/ Utilities/ Corporate Organizations/ Autonomous Bodies/ Research & Educational Institutions in India shall be uploaded in the sample format Annexure-A. However, with respect to the Annexure-A format, it is only a sample format and tenderer can upload any format, but it should cover all parameters as mentioned in Annexure-A. Micro & Small Enterprises shall upload valid MSME (UDYAM) registration certificate obtained from the competent authority certifying that tenderer is a Micro and Small Enterprises.
The Tenderer shall comply with all the mandatory Technical Specification.Scanned copy of the self-declaration on notarized stamp paper of Rs.100/- shall be uploaded.
tenderTechnicalCriterionList.criterionTypeOthersValue: Self declaration - Comply with all the mandatory Technical Specification

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer /OEM must have valid ISO 9001:2015 & ISO/IEC 20000-1-2018 or above version pertaining to Software/IT services as on the date of tender notification.The tenderer shall scan in original and upload valid relevant ISO certificates
The Proposed Hardwares End-of-Life should not be less than Five years from the date of work award. The Certificate issued by OEM should be submitted by the tenderer.
One OEM shall have Maximum of 3 Tenderers only and if more than 3, the first 3 will be considered & rest will be disqualified. The OEM MAF certificate shall be evaluated in Chronological order.
tenderTechnicalCriterionList.criterionTypeOthersValue: OEM MAF certificate shall be evaluated in Chronological order

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- OEM MAF certificate shall be evaluated in Chronological order

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: OEM/Tenderer should be genuine and authorized listed vendor in Microsoft for re-selling Windows operating system and Microsoft Office licenses. Operating System and Microsoft Office License certificate issued by Microsoft corporation to be submitted w.r.t Proposed Windows operating system (the certificate shall consist of proposed operating system, model no and bid specific confirmation).

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Any Tenderer from a country which shares a land with India will be eligible to bid in this tender only if the Tenderer is registered with the Competent Authority. A certificate for having read the clauses specified in Section-XVI of the tender documents under the heading Eligibility clauses in respect of restrictions on procurement from a Tenderer of a country which shares a land border with India shall be uploaded by the Tenderer in the following format:i)I have read the clause regarding restrictions on procurement from a Tenderer of a country which shares a land border with India I certify that this Tenderer is not from such a country or, if from such a country, has been registered with the Competent Authority. I hereby certify that this Tenderer, fulfills all equirements in this regard and is eligible to be considered . (Where applicable, evidence of valid registration by the Competent Authority shall be attached/ uploaded.) ii)I have read the clause regarding restrictions on procurement from a Tenderer/vendor having Transfer of Technology (ToT) arrangement. I certify that this Tenderer or does not have any ToT arrangement requiring registration with the competent authority . OR I have read the clause regarding restrictions on procurement from a Tenderer/vendor having Transfer of Technology (ToT) arrangement. I certify that this Tenderer/vendor has valid registration to participate in this procurement. Registration certificate issued by the competent authority shall be uploaded.Scanned copy of the self-declaration on notarized stamp paper of Rs.100/- in the prescribed format shall be uploaded.

The Tenderer should not have been DEFAULTED in supplies against Purchase Orders placed by any ESCOMs/Distribution companies or any Government Electrical Utilities/PSUs.Scanned copy of the self-declaration on notarized stamp paper of Rs.100/- by the Tenderer adhering to this clause shall be uploaded.
